command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-11b. THE ACCEPTANCE TEST, read on the far side of the reboot.
#
# The owner's pass condition, verbatim: prove EXACTLY ONE Ollama comes back -- the Windows-owned P40
# service, same models, same API contract, loopback-only. If both runtimes appear, or compose
# recreates the old container, COMMISSIONING FAILS.
#
# This also settles the power-cap durability finding, and it is the only moment that can. The cap
# was 150 W before the reboot with persistence mode N/A, so the boot must have cleared it to the
# 250 W default; the service's startup path logs what it FOUND before applying. That line either
# reads 250 W -- proving the cap really does evaporate and the mechanism really does restore it --
# or it does not, and the finding was wrong. Either way it is measured, not argued.

Write-Output '--- IDENTITY-AND-FRESHNESS ---'
Write-Output "hostname=$env:COMPUTERNAME"
Write-Output "now_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "boot_utc=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "prior_boot_was=2026-08-25T01:40:10.5000000Z  (a different value here proves the reboot happened)"
Write-Output "uptime_minutes=$([math]::Round(((Get-Date) - (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime).TotalMinutes, 1))"

Write-Output '--- HOW-MANY-OLLAMAS ---'
Write-Output "containers_named_ollama=$((docker ps -a --filter name=ollama --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' 2>&1) -join ' ;; ')"
Write-Output '--- ALL-CONTAINERS ---'
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}|{{.Image}}' 2>&1
Write-Output '--- HOST-OLLAMA-PROCESSES ---'
Get-Process -Name 'ollama*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 160
Write-Output "listeners_11434:"
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11434 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80

Write-Output '--- CANONICAL-SERVICE ---'
$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "task_state=$($t.State)"
Write-Output "task_last_result=$((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastTaskResult)"
Write-Output "task_last_run=$((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastRunTime)"

Write-Output '--- SAME-API-CONTRACT ---'
try { Write-Output "api_version=$((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version' -TimeoutSec 10).version)" } catch { Write-Output "version_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
try {
    $tags = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 20
    Write-Output "api_models=$($tags.models.Count) list=$(($tags.models.name | Sort-Object) -join ',')"
} catch { Write-Output "tags_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
try { $oa = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/models' -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "v1_models=$($oa.data.Count)" } catch { Write-Output "v1_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

Write-Output '--- LOOPBACK-ONLY ---'
foreach ($a in (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^127\.' })) {
    $c = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient
    $verdict = 'refused'
    try { if ($c.ConnectAsync($a.IPAddress, 11434).Wait(2500) -and $c.Connected) { $verdict = 'CONNECTED' } } catch { }
    finally { $c.Close() }
    Write-Output "iface=$($a.InterfaceAlias) ip=$($a.IPAddress) port11434=$verdict"
}

Write-Output '--- POWER-CAP-DURABILITY ---'
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,persistence_mode,power.limit,power.default_limit,temperature.gpu,power.draw --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- SERVICE-LOG-THIS-BOOT ---'
Get-Content 'C:\ProgramData\WilliamOS\logs\hermes-ollama-service.log' -Tail 14 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Output '--- COMPOSE-DID-NOT-RESURRECT-OLLAMA ---'
Write-Output "compose_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())  (expected bbdf7b1c2e0da063302bd90a790c8f28fab83be0704d8254a419c91944064c35)"
docker compose -f 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml' --project-directory 'C:\HermesLab\hermes' config --services 2>&1
Write-Output "ollama_image_retained=$(docker images ollama/ollama --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}}' 2>&1)"

Write-Output '--- MODELS-INTACT ---'
$b = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File | Measure-Object -Sum Length
Write-Output "blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum)  (expected 21 / 10360071891)"

Write-Output '--- OPEN-WEBUI-STILL-CONNECTED ---'
$r = docker exec open-webui python3 -c "import urllib.request,json
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/tags', timeout=10))
print('models', len(d['models']))" 2>&1
Write-Output "from_open_webui => $($r -join ' | ')"

Write-Output '--- INFERENCE-STILL-LANDS-ON-P40 ---'
try {
    $body = @{ model = 'llama3.2:3b'; prompt = 'Reply with exactly one word: commissioned'; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 16; temperature = 0 } } | ConvertTo-Json
    $g = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
    Write-Output "generate_ok response=$($g.response.Trim() -replace '\s+', ' ') eval_count=$($g.eval_count)"
    if ($g.eval_duration -gt 0) { Write-Output "decode_tok_per_s=$([math]::Round($g.eval_count / ($g.eval_duration / 1e9), 2))" }
} catch { Write-Output "generate_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.used,utilization.gpu,power.draw,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
